title: Rotate Array Left by K
statement:
Given an array of N integers and a non-negative integer K, rotate the array to the left by K positions and print the result.

A left rotation by 1 moves the first element to the last position.

For example, rotating [1,2,3,4,5] left by 2 gives [3,4,5,1,2].

Note: K may be larger than N; use K mod N.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers on a single line representing the rotated array.

examples.explanation: Left rotate by 2: first two elements (1,2) move to the end.
Rotating by N is the same as no rotation.
